description.value: Pizzeria Ludica is a thin-crust, stone-oven pizza restaurant combined with a vast free-to-play board game library — hundreds of board and card games available at no extra charge with a meal. Located near the Columbia SkyTrain station in New Westminster, it is a family-friendly destination that encourages lingering over games after eating. The eclectic concept makes it a memorable stop for cyclists looking for a substantial sit-down meal with something to do off the bike.
